articles.title: What is Habeep?
articles.subtitle: Learn more about Habeep
articles.content: Habeep is a groundbreaking mobile application that aims to revolutionise real estate in Nigeria. It serves as a comprehensive platform, bridging the gap between tenants, landlords, and real estate management firms. Habeep enhances the renting experience for all parties involved by offering innovative features and services.

articles.title: How does Habeep benefit House Agents?
articles.subtitle: Learn more about Habeep
articles.content: Habeep benefits Agents, by providing a user-friendly interface to search for rental properties, connect directly with potential clients, thereby easing the stress of having to look for clients.

articles.title: What are the advantages of becoming a certified agent on Habeep?
articles.subtitle: Learn more about Habeep
articles.content:
Becoming a certified agent on Habeep comes with numerous advantages, including:

  • Access to a user-friendly interface to manage listings and interactions with clients.
  • A vast network of potential clients actively seeking rental properties.
  • Participation in the innovative Residual Income Program with attractive referral incentives.
  • Exposure to a dynamic community of agents for collaboration and support.

articles.title: How can I become a certified agent on Habeep?
articles.subtitle: Learn more about Habeep
articles.content:
To become a certified agent on Habeep, follow these steps:

  • Download the Habeep app from the Playstore or visit the website.
  • Sign up with your email and create a four-digit PIN for security.
  • Log into your account and tap on 'Become an Agent'.
  • Fill the form with your name, location, and other basic information.
  • Make a one-time payment of 50 HBP ($0.11) using your Habeep wallet and unlock the next level of your real estate career.

articles.title: How does Habeep's Referral Program work?
articles.subtitle: Learn more about Habeep
articles.content:
Habeep's Referral Program allows certified agents to earn a 40% commission for every agent they refer to the platform.


When the referred agent completes transactions, both the referring and referred agents receive commission rewards. This program is a fantastic opportunity to build residual income and expand your network.
